topics.title: OPFS + Pyodide test harness
topics.summary:
Tool: OPFS + Pyodide test harness

I've been pondering if Datasette Lite - the Python Datasette application run entirely in the browser using Pyodide and WebAssembly - might be able to edit persistent SQLite files stored on the user's computer.

That's what OFPS (Origin Private File System) is for, so I had Claude Code for web build me this playground UI to try it out in different browsers.

Tags: browsers, pyodide,

items.title: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
items.summary: We introduce NatureBench, a cross-discipline benchmark of 90 tasks distilled from peer-reviewed Nature-family publications, designed to evaluate whether AI coding agents can move beyond reproduction toward discovery on real scientific problems.
